name: uphealther
description: One command to set up, one to start and one to test the repository, which CI runs too (ADR-044); and one to write a release's changelog (ADR-051).

scripts.test: npm run test:diagrams && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:images
scripts.test:frontend: cd frontend && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:colours && npm run test:coverage && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm run build
scripts.test:backend: node scripts/mvnw.mjs -B --no-transfer-progress clean verify && npm run audit:backend
scripts.changelog: docker compose -f scripts/compose.changelog.yml run --rm git-cliff --unreleased --prepend CHANGELOG.md
